visual_action: Kamala Harris speaks at a podium to a large, enthusiastic crowd. People in the audience hold up blue campaign signs, including some that read "HARRIS WALZ" and "VOTE FOR FREEDOM". Harris smiles and gestures as she speaks.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is the sole speaker in the video, shown in a medium shot for the entire duration.

cast.name: Jimmy Carter
cast.evidence: Harris's speech and the on-screen text are centered on the fact that Jimmy Carter voted early. She says, "If Jimmy Carter can vote early, you can too!"

on_screen_text.text: "If Jimmy Carter can vote early, you can too!" 👏👏

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris tells a crowd in Georgia that former President Jimmy Carter voted early, just days after his 100th birthday. The crowd cheers loudly at this news. Harris then concludes, "So look, if Jimmy Carter can vote early, you can too!"
audio_music: The audio consists of Kamala Harris's voice speaking, with prominent, enthusiastic cheering and applause from the live audience. There is no music.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of Kamala Harris speaking. Animated captions in a yellow font appear on screen, synchronized with her speech.
central_claim: If 100-year-old former President Jimmy Carter can vote early, then everyone else should be able to and has no excuse not to.
intended_effect: To motivate viewers to participate in early voting by holding up Jimmy Carter as an inspiring example of civic duty.
